configuration.title: Physical inductive bias and knowledge distillation for lightweight Doppler estimation

G1_learning_feasibility.criteria: noiseless MAE<1 Hz and P95<5 Hz for >=2/3 seeds; 20 dB RMSE at least 50% below zero predictor

G3_distillation_value.criteria: paired 95% CI wholly below zero at two adjacent primary SNR points and at least 2/3 seed-level RMSE deltas below zero at each point
